variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ossian the innkeeper who also makes coffins, Dunstan's flat slogan, Mabry the comic potion seller.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Welcome to the Drowned Lantern. I rent the rooms, and I make the coffins for the whole town.

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: This is Dunstan's forge. Best steel on the Bracken! How can I help you?

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Welcome to Mabry's Magnificent Magicks, sole supplier of potions to Brackenford and surrounding areas! Buy something, please. My cat hasn't eaten since Tuesday!

variants.specifics: Bormunt: Grumwald of the Sooty Lamp inn, Hask the smith who also pulls teeth, Ilvane of the Azure Circle.

inn.speaker: Grumwald
inn.text: You're not from around here, are you? Too much sun on your face! What'll it be?

arms.speaker: Hask
arms.text: Arms and armor, best in Bormunt. I pull teeth too, if you need one out.

magic.speaker: Ilvane
magic.text: The Azure Circle is the sole purveyor of potions and scrolls to the mines of Bormunt. State your needs.

variants.specifics: Oskry: Durl of the Dry Plank inn, Skarrow the armorer, Zanthe who sells potions and spell books.

inn.speaker: Durl
inn.text: Welcome to the Dry Plank! Driest beds in the swamp! Well... Mostly dry.

arms.speaker: Skarrow
arms.text: Welcome to Skarrow's Arms and Armor! Look around, take your time.

magic.speaker: Zanthe
magic.text: Ahh, come in! I've got potions and spell books, and you've got gold. We'll get along fine!

variants.specifics: Castle Brask: Hulda of the Iron Kettle, Bortho the armourer, Quigg of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Hulda
inn.text: Welcome to the Iron Kettle, victuallers to the garrison of Castle Brask. Soldiers eat first.

arms.speaker: Bortho
arms.text: A customer! Half the street's packed up and gone since the dead started walking. I'll be next if business doesn't pick up.

magic.speaker: Quigg
magic.text: Hello, hello! Welcome to Quigg's Magic and Goat Rental! Potions in the front, goats out back! You look like a fella who needs a goat!

variants.specifics: Vesk: Hulda of the Leaky Bucket inn, Bodkin Mudd the arms dealer who also sells bait, Dorgo of the potion shop.

inn.speaker: Hulda
inn.text: Welcome to the Leaky Bucket. Not many folk come out this way since the dead started walking. Take any room you like, they're all empty.

arms.speaker: Bodkin Mudd
arms.text: Welcome to Mudd's! Finest blades on the lake, and the fattest worms! Go on, smell one. Fresh dug this mornin'!

magic.speaker: Dorgo
magic.text: Ah, a customer! My potions cost a bit more than in the city. But then, the city is a long row away, isn't it?

variants.specifics: Vorne: Grenda of the Singing Kettle inn, Brask the armorer who mends cauldrons on the side, Velka of the magic shop who has no time for talk.

inn.speaker: Grenda
inn.text: Welcome to the Singing Kettle, finest inn in all of Nox! Well... finest in Vorne, anyway. Sit yerself down.

arms.speaker: Brask
arms.text: Welcome, stranger! Weapons and armor out front. I also mend cauldrons, if you've got one that leaks.

magic.speaker: Velka
magic.text: I sell potions and scrolls, not conversation. What do you want?

variants.specifics: Fort Kholm: Olva of the Snowbound Inn, Thudd of Thudd's Armory, Yeva who sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Olva
inn.text: Welcome to the Snowbound Inn. Not a single guest since the pass was closed. I'm thinking of packing up and going down the mountain myself.

arms.speaker: Thudd
arms.text: Welcome to Thudd's Armory! Best steel on the mountain! And if it won't kill the Undead, you can always use it to chip the ice off your beard!

magic.speaker: Yeva
magic.text: Ah, a customer! I do hope your purse is heavy, Wanderer. Everything costs a little more this far up the mountain.

variants.specifics: Fornath: Hesta of the Slag Pot inn (bad times), Gundrek the armourer (a wink at the price), Zibba of the potion shop (the town's one comic person).

inn.speaker: Hesta
inn.text: Welcome to the Slag Pot. Ain't hardly nobody come up the mountain since them Ogres moved in. I'm about ready to pack it in fer good.

arms.speaker: Gundrek
arms.text: Fornath steel, the best money can buy! And you look like you have a good deal of money.

magic.speaker: Zibba
magic.text: Ooh, a new face! I can always spot the new ones, they've still got their eyebrows! Come in, come in!

variants.specifics: Wendle Cross: Odo of the Crooked Kettle inn, Grimsel the smith, Quimby of Quimby's Potions and Notions.

inn.speaker: Odo
inn.text: Welcome to the Crooked Kettle! Prices went up a bit since the roads closed. Can't be helped, friend!

arms.speaker: Grimsel
arms.text: What now? Half the hamlet wants a sword mended today. Buy something or get out of my light.

magic.speaker: Quimby
magic.text: Ooh, you're new around here! I can always tell -- you've still got both your eyebrows! Welcome to Quimby's Potions and Notions!

variants.specifics: Hestle: Hulda of the Sleepy Ox inn, Gorrick the smith, and Pidwick the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Hulda
inn.text: You want a room? Pay first. And wipe your boots, I just did the floors.

arms.speaker: Gorrick
arms.text: Welcome! I make armor for heroes and horseshoes for everybody else. What'll it be?

magic.speaker: Pidwick
magic.text: Ahhh! A customer! Come in, come in! Everything's priced to sell, and what doesn't sell, I drink myself! Hee, hee, hee!
